results.question: What was Agnico Eagle's all-in sustaining cost per ounce on a by-product basis in the third quarter of 2026?
results.answer:
Agnico Eagle's all-in sustaining cost (AISC) per ounce on a by-product basis for the third quarter of 2026 (three months ended September 30, 2026) was **US$1,648 per ounce** on a consolidated basis (AEM_q3_2026.pdf, p.42).

For comparison, the co-product basis figure for the same quarter was US$1,740 per ounce (p.42). The Q3 2025 by-product figure was US$1,331 per ounce (p.42).

results.answer:
